subject.title: fix(ai): add handshake timeout to ChatGPT Responses WebSocket connect

question: Should ChatGPT Responses use a fixed 30-second connection-phase deadline by default, with an explicit request `timeoutMs` governing that same phase, even when a slow existing WebSocket upgrade might otherwise eventually succeed?
rationale: The implementation is a bounded reliability repair, but selecting the default deadline and fallback tradeoff changes provider behavior for existing slow connections; that compatibility policy requires maintainer intent after checking the upstream Codex runtime contract.

options.title: Adopt the bounded handshake contract
options.body: Confirm that 30 seconds is the intended default and merge after rebasing plus direct Codex/provider contract verification.

options.title: Preserve unbounded default behavior
options.body: Keep the existing default and pursue a narrower opt-in or caller-owned timeout strategy if compatibility with very slow upgrades is preferred.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded handshake contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that 30 seconds is the intended default and merge after rebasing plus direct Codex/provider contract verification.
